en.headline: Security guard jailed four months for dumping resident's cat in rubbish bin
en.dek: Chau Wing-lok, 62, admitted one count of animal cruelty at Kowloon City Magistrates' Courts after placing a lost cat in a plastic bag and discarding it at Lee Kee Building in Ngau Tau Kok last August.
body: A 62-year-old security guard was sentenced to four months' imprisonment on Thursday after admitting he had bagged a lost domestic cat and dumped it in an open rubbish bin at a residential building in Ngau Tau Kok.

Chau Wing-lok was on night duty at Lee Kee Building on 6 August 2025 when the incident occurred. Closed-circuit television footage showed him carrying a knotted black plastic bag containing the cat into a refuse station and placing it in a bin without a lid. The bin was later emptied and the animal was never recovered. The court concluded the cat had been taken to a landfill and died.

The cat belonged to a resident of a neighbouring unit on the ninth floor. Chau told police he found the animal unresponsive, regarded the situation as troublesome and did not know how else to handle it. He pleaded guilty to one count of cruelty to animals. Magistrate Betty Lau Suk-han said the act of taking the animal's life made a custodial sentence inevitable and that the impact on the owner was an aggravating factor. Mitigation including Chau's previous work record and health condition did not alter the outcome.

zh.headline: 牛頭角保安員將走失貓丟入垃圾桶判囚四個月
zh.dek: 62歲周姓保安員承認一項殘酷對待動物罪，於九龍城裁判法院被判即時入獄四個月，案涉去年8月在利基大廈將走失家貓裝袋棄置。
body: 一名62歲保安員星期四被判入獄四個月，他承認將一隻走失的家貓裝進膠袋後丟進牛頭角一個住宅大廈的垃圾桶，構成殘酷對待動物。
周永樂（音譯）於2025年8月6日在利基大廈值夜班時涉事。閉路電視畫面顯示他手持一個打結的黑色膠袋進入垃圾站，將袋子放入沒有蓋的垃圾桶。其後垃圾桶被清走，貓隻再無尋回。法庭裁定貓隻已被運往堆填區並死亡。
貓隻屬於九樓鄰單位一名居民。周某向警方表示發現貓隻時已無反應，認為處理麻煩而不知如何是好。他承認一項殘酷對待動物罪。裁判官劉淑嫻指出，被告奪去動物生命的行為令監禁刑罰無可避免，而對飼主造成的影響屬加重情節。辯方提出的過往工作表現及健康狀況等求情因素未能改變判刑。
